statement: Under the stationary interface stated at the start of this section, the Killing field is timelike on the whole open exterior: W > 0 on Ω◦. The original matter densities vanish there, X ∧ E = 0, and dAs = 0. The orbit pair (hs, λ) has the regular attachment in Lemma 9.5. If Q ̸= 0, define (h0, λ0) by (9.42); if Q = 0, take (h0, λ0) = (hs, λ). In either case this is a smooth vacuum static pair satisfying (9.43) on a connected orientable exterior, complete including its connected compact boundary, with compact complement of exactly one Euclidean coordinate end. Its lapse is zero at the boundary, lies strictly between zero and one in the interior, and tends to one at infinity. The inward boundary derivative is a positive constant, equal to (9.44) in the charged case and to κ in the uncharged case. The boundary is totally geodesic and Hessh0 λ0 = 0 there. Gaussian reflection of h0 with odd reflection of λ0 is at least C2,α for 0 < α < 1. After a fixed linear change of end coordinates, h0 − δ = O2(r−q0 ), λ0 − 1 = O2(r−q0 ) (9.52) for q0 as in (9.7). No simple-connectivity claim or global primitive of As is needed for this reduction.
